description: Application to clear condition 20 (as-built energy statement SAP output calculations) and 22 (overheating report) of approved application DM2025/00548.
decision_conditions: The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement prepared by Air Acoustics Ltd and dated 8 April 2025. Prior to first occupation, 'as-built' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as thedevelopment is in existence.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved TM59 Dynamic Summertime Overheating prepared by Energy Acoustics Ltd and dated 8 October 2024. Prior to first occupation of the development, documentary evidence including finalised dynamic thermal modelling results must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which demonstrates that the overheating strategy has been implemented in line with the approveddetails.
